kind.description: questions: you need answers before a spec; spec: the spec is ready; out-of-reach: the change cannot be made by the implementation agent

type.description: For a spec: bug or feature. Otherwise none

questions.description: For questions: 1 to 5 questions, each one line. Otherwise empty

reason.description: For out-of-reach: why, in plain words. Otherwise empty

what.description: For a spec: one line, what changes

why.description: For a spec: one line, why

changes.description: For a spec: one line, what the developer will see or have to do differently

size.description: For a spec: S, M or L. Otherwise none

spec.description: For a spec: the full spec in Markdown. Otherwise empty

assumed.description: For a spec: every product decision you took that the developer did not state, each a few words on one line. Empty if none, and for the other kinds

workaround.description: For a spec: when the natural way is out of reach and the spec does it another way that delivers less or hand-makes a standard tool, one line: what is left out and what the natural way would need. Otherwise empty

facts.description: For a spec: what the change touches. All false for the other kinds

access.description: Who may see or change what changes, or data could be lost

existing.description: Existing behaviour, API, wording a user sees, or stored data changes

schema.description: The database schema changes (a new Liquibase changeset)
